name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-report (report to a polished dark HTML page, from a doc or from session findings), arch-map (derived architecture maps), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), writing-skills (TDD for skill authoring, derived from obra/superpowers, MIT), get-pr-comments (triages a PR's feedback into a prioritized action list, read-only), adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, rules, and Claude output styles onto a machine, additively), and me-human (act as a human user dogfooding a system for real work). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.

interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Workshop toolkit plugin. Codex exposes the html-report, ui-demo-video, arch-map, writing-skills, get-pr-comments, adopt-global-rules, and me-human skills from this package: the optional layer next to the workbench plugin.
defaultPrompt: Turn a markdown report into a standalone HTML page.
Draw an architecture map of a subsystem or refactor as a standalone page.
Record a UI demo video of a change in the running app.
Author or edit a skill with baseline testing.
Install the workshop's global CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and rules onto this machine.
Use this system the way a real human user would, and report what got in the way.
